svg.title: workstation-steward: your config repo, watched and kept in step
svg.desc: An illustrative session, looping, in five scenes. A bare steward shows a banner line: a policy file changed here and one newer commit on GitHub, as of the last fetch, pointing to steward config sync. steward config ends with the repo section, each item with steward config sync. steward review fetches the config repo and lists the same, plus its open pull requests, such as Renovate's. steward config sync --apply then shows its plan (pull Renovate's merged commit, send the local edit), fast-forwards after a yes, runs mise install after a yes and steward check, and sends the edit as pull request #7 on a new steward/sync branch, where this Mac stays until the merge. After #7 is merged on GitHub, the next sync switches back to main, fast-forwards, deletes the branch and runs steward check.
